texts.zh:
我们在[from.target.capital_scope.GetName]上的两名关键特工在一场意料之外的自然灾害中身受重伤，该灾害同样造成了许多[from.target.GetSpeciesNamePlural]伤亡。附近居民紧急驰援，那几名特工现在得到了基本的照料。

[from.target.GetSpeciesNamePlural]还没能开始质疑我们的特工，尽管他们伤势严重，但和当地的大量受灾者相比不算什么。用不了多久，[from.GetName]行动就会受到更严格的审查——尤其是在我们的两名关键特工身体不适的情况下。
texts.en:
Two of our key operatives on [from.target.capital_scope.GetName] have been seriously injured during an unexpected, natural disaster which also claimed the lives of several [from.target.GetSpeciesNamePlural]. Local residents rushed to their aid; the operatives in question are now being given rudimentary care.

The [from.target.GetSpeciesNamePlural] have not yet been able to question our operatives, however their injuries - though severe - are nothing compared to what struck down so many native bystanders. It cannot be long before Operation [from.GetName] is put under significantly greater scrutiny - especially with two of our key agents indisposed.

texts.zh:
我们在[from.target.capital_scope.GetName]上的两名关键特工在一场意料之外的自然灾害中身受重伤，该灾害同样摧毁了许多[from.target.GetSpeciesAdj]子个体。帮助者们紧急驰援，并将我们那两名负伤特工带走进行基本的照料。

目前，[from.target.GetSpeciesAdj]蜂巢主倾向于关照那些更严重的毁伤上。但用不了多久，[from.GetName]行动就会受到更严格的审查——尤其是在我们的两名关键特工身体不适的情况下。我们有极大的暴露风险。
texts.en:
Two of our key operatives on [from.target.capital_scope.GetName] have been seriously injured during an unexpected, natural disaster which also destroyed several [from.target.GetSpeciesAdj] drones. Helpers rushed to provide aid, and have removed our stricken operatives to a rudimentary care nodule.

For now, the [from.target.GetSpeciesAdj] hive is pre-occupied with tending to its more severe injuries. However, it cannot be long before Operation [from.GetName] comes under greater scrutiny - especially with two of our key agents indisposed. We are at great risk of exposure.

label.zh: 我们必须相信他们的掩护靠得住。
label.en: We must trust that their cover will hold.

label.zh: 我们不能冒风险暴露！中止行动。
label.en: We cannot risk this kind of exposure! Abort.

label.zh: 是时候揭示我们的真面目了。
label.en: It is time we reveal ourselves.

tooltips.zh: 将我们的特工完全托付给[from.target.GetSpeciesAdj]的医疗照料。这将会对[from.GetName]行动造成负面的影响。
tooltips.en: Entrust our operatives fully to [from.target.GetSpeciesAdj] medical care. This will have a negative impact on Operation [from.GetName].

label.zh: 是时候揭示我们的真面目了。
label.en: It is time we reveal ourselves.

tooltips.zh: 将我们的特工完全托付给[from.target.GetSpeciesAdj]的医疗照料。这将会对[from.GetName]行动造成正面的影响。
tooltips.en: Entrust our operatives fully to [from.target.GetSpeciesAdj] medical care. This will have a positive impact on Operation [from.GetName].

texts.zh: 间谍首脑 [from.spynetwork.leader.GetName]汇报，我们的受伤特工已经从[from.target.capital_scope.GetName]当地的的医疗设施中撤离。在[from.target.GetSpeciesNamePlural]的视角里，这些“幸存者”们受到了隐蔽的致命伤。他们遗体的复制品已经被妥善处置了。
texts.en: Spymaster [from.spynetwork.leader.GetName] reports the successful extraction of our injured operatives from a care facility on [from.target.capital_scope.GetName]. As far as the [from.target.GetSpeciesNamePlural] are concerned, these 'survivors' succumbed to hidden, fatal injuries. Facsimiles of their remains are already being disposed of.

texts.zh:
间谍首脑 [from.spynetwork.leader.GetName]紧急汇报，从[from.target.capital_scope.GetName]地表撤回受伤特工的行动失败了。几个[from.target.GetSpeciesAdj]目击了他们认为的“绑架未遂”，并带着他们的偏见强加干预。他们不仅加强了对那几名受伤特工的安保，甚至还逮捕了我们救援队的成员！

[from.target.GetSpeciesName]现在高度警惕。至少在某种意义上来说，[from.GetName]行动已经败露了。
texts.en:
Spymaster [from.spynetwork.leader.GetName] urgently reports a failure to extract our stricken operatives from the surface of [from.target.capital_scope.GetName]. Several [from.target.GetSpeciesAdj] witnessed what they perceived as an attempted abduction, and intervened with great prejudice. They have not only tightened security around our injured operatives, but have also apprehended members of our rescue team!

The [from.target.GetSpeciesName] are now on high alert. To some extent at least, Operation [from.GetName] has been exposed.

tooltips.zh: [from.GetName]行动将克服该负面障碍继续进行。
tooltips.en: Operation [from.GetName] will resume despite this negative setback.

texts.zh:
[global_event_country.GetGalCommunityOrGalImperium]的官员收到消息称我们干涉[pre_ftl_country.GetName]自然发展。他们告知我们这毫无疑问违反了不予干涉法案，无论我们的本意如何。

[Root.GetName]在接下来的十年内将会被视为违反星系法。此外，我们还应缴纳巨额罚金。
texts.en:
Officials from the [global_event_country.GetGalCommunityOrGalImperium] have received word of our interference in the natural development of the [pre_ftl_country.GetName]. They have informed us that this is a clear violation of the Non-Interference Act, regardless of our intentions.

The [Root.GetName] will be considered in Breach of Galactic Law for the next ten years. In addition, we have been issued with a hefty fine.

texts.zh:
[global_event_country.GetGalCommunityOrGalImperium]的官员们裁定，无论我们的用意为何，我们与[pre_ftl_country.GetName]的协议已经违反了平等相待法案。

[Root.GetName]在接下来的十年内将会被视为违反星系法。此外，我们还应缴纳巨额罚金。
texts.en:
Officials from the [global_event_country.GetGalCommunityOrGalImperium] have determined that our treatment of the [pre_ftl_country.GetName] is in violation of the Equal Standing Act, regardless of our intentions.

The [Root.GetName] will be considered in Breach of Galactic Law for the next ten years. In addition, we have been issued with a hefty fine.

texts.zh: 我们在[pre_ftl_country.GetName]违反不予干涉法案一事发生后，已经向[global_event_country.GetGalCommunityOrGalImperium]的官员递交了完整报告。希望这种坦白的行为能让检察官对我们有好感，他们或许会对我们的案子从宽处理。
texts.en: We have submitted a full report to officials at the [global_event_country.GetGalCommunityOrGalImperium], following our violation of the Non-Interference Act in the [pre_ftl_country.GetName]. Hopefully this confessional act of disclosure will endear us to prosecutors, who may in turn consider our case more leniently.

texts.zh:
由于与[pre_ftl_country.GetName]的协议违反了平等相待法案，我们在此后向[global_event_country.GetGalCommunityOrGalImperium]的官员们递交了必要的文书。希望通过承认我们的行动他们可能网开一面。

[Root.GetName]在接下来的五年内将会被视为违反星系法。此外，我们还应缴纳巨额罚金。
texts.en:
Following our violation of the Equal Standing Act due to our treatment of the [pre_ftl_country.GetName], we have submitted the requisite paperwork to the officials of the [global_event_country.GetGalCommunityOrGalImperium]. Hopefully, by admitting our actions they will be more tolerant.

The [Root.GetName] will be considered in Breach of Galactic Law for the next five years. In addition, we have been issued with a hefty fine.

texts.zh:
我们的掩护依然没有暴露。我们的特工几乎奇迹般地逃脱了致命伤这件事确实引起了一些怀疑，但[from.target.GetSpeciesNamePlural]似乎认为运气只是站在他们这一边。

我们的特工们还要有一段时日才能回到岗位上，但他们现在已经进行了述职汇报。[from.GetName]行动将会恢复其首要日程。
texts.en:
Our cover remains in tact. Although the near-miraculous manner in which our operatives escaped fatal injury did raise some suspicion, the [from.target.GetSpeciesNamePlural] appear to have decided that luck was simply on their side.

It will be a while yet before our agents can return to duty, however they have now been debriefed. Operation [from.GetName] may return to its prior schedule.

texts.zh:
间谍首脑 [from.spynetwork.leader.GetName]紧急汇报，我们没能在[from.target.GetName]维持伪装。尽管他们训练有素并拥有我们所能提供的最好的伪装科技，但我们的特工非[from.target.GetSpeciesNamePlural]的身份还是暴露了。

幸运的是当地人并没有惊慌失措，我们的特工暂时也没有受到伤害。然而，继续掩盖他们的存在和行动的成功希望非常渺茫。似乎我们必须处理迫在眉睫的后果了。
texts.en:
Spymaster [from.spynetwork.leader.GetName] urgently reports our failure to maintain cover in the [from.target.GetName]. Despite thorough training and access to the best covert technology we could provide, our operatives have been exposed as non-[from.target.GetSpeciesNamePlural].

Fortunately the locals did not panic, and our operatives remain unharmed for the time being. However, our chances of successfully disavowing them and their actions are extremely slim. It seems we must simply deal with the consequences now before us.

texts.zh:
间谍首脑 [from.spynetwork.leader.GetName]紧急汇报，我们没能在[from.target.GetName]维持伪装。尽管他们训练有素并拥有我们所能提供的最好的伪装科技，但我们的特工非[from.target.GetSpeciesNamePlural]的身份还是暴露了。

严峻的现实对我们的特工来说相当致命：他们正在接受基本手术时，[from.target.GetSpeciesAdj]的护理人员发现了他们的真实身份，并为此惊慌失措。
texts.en:
Spymaster [from.spynetwork.leader.GetName] urgently reports our failure to maintain cover in the [from.target.GetName]. Despite thorough training and access to the best covert technology we could provide, our operatives have been exposed as non-[from.target.GetSpeciesNamePlural].

This stark realization has proven fatal for our operatives: they were undergoing rudimentary surgery when [from.target.GetSpeciesAdj] care-givers discovered their true nature, and panicked.
